subhead: Important: The EQV is a fully electric variant of the V-Class. We do not rebuild or replace electric motors — our specialist expertise covers combustion engines only. This page exists to confirm we cannot help with EQV electric drivetrain work, and to direct you to the correct V-Class combustion-engine variants we do cover.
